precepts.text: Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee. Thy children shall die of hunger, thy cities shall be broken down, and they that be in the mountains shall die of hunger and eat their own flesh: everybody thinks they have a plan for when Armageddon takes place, we will go into the bunkers and survive there; no, that is not going to happen. And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed. Although the country of Babylon the great is wiped out, her military is not finished; that is why America keeps over 800 military bases worldwide, which no other nation has, not Russia, not China. That is how they reach Moab even after the homeland is destroyed. Thy children shall they carry away captive, and look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face.
precepts.point: For thus saith the Lord; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab. Whose symbol is the eagle? America. The eagle spreads his wings over Moab, and Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.

note.label: The Madmen Of China And Their Hatred For Black People

precepts.why:
Jeremiah says Moab “shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the Lord.” Ezra shows the same judgment and why it comes: “Like as thou hast done unto my chosen, saith the Lord, even so shall God do unto thee, and shall deliver thee into mischief”. It goes into what they did to us. What was done to the chosen will be done back to them.

Remember who the subject is. Back in verse 46: “And thou, Asia, that art partaker of the hope of Babylon, and art the glory of her person”. This is Asia, East Asia in particular, the same Moab of Jeremiah 48 that burns incense to all kinds of gods and ancestors.

“Thy children shall die of hunger, and thou shalt fall through the sword: thy cities shall be broken down, and all thine shall perish with the sword in the field. They that be in the mountains shall die of hunger, and eat their own flesh, and drink their own blood”. That is cannibalism. They that be in the mountains are the ones in those bunkers, little bunkers, big bunkers, all kinds of bunkers. Everybody thinks they have a plan for when Armageddon takes place and all nations fight: we will go into the bunkers, we will survive there, we will live there for a century. No, that is not going to happen.

“And in the passage they shall rush on the idle city, and shall destroy some portion of thy land, and consume part of thy glory, and shall return to Babylon that was destroyed.” The idle city is China. And it shows America is not finished yet. Although the country, Babylon the great, the United States of America, gets wiped out, her military is not finished. That is why America has over 800 military bases worldwide, and it is the only country that has that. Russia doesn't have that, China doesn't have that. Their home base is finished, but they have bases everywhere, and that is how they will successfully get China; then they return and see Babylon destroyed.

“Thy children shall they carry away captive, and, look, what thou hast, they shall spoil it, and mar the beauty of thy face.” Those are prisoners of war. It is the same as Jeremiah, where the mighty men’s hearts in Moab are “as the heart of a woman in her pangs”, very fearful, scared and afraid: “thy sons are taken captives, and thy daughters captives.” Whatever China says in its pride, God says it shall not be so. Nobody gets away with what they did to God's chosen people.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her: you did business with America, you got rich, you did America's bidding. They shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city, for in one hour is thy judgment come. It is the same wording as Esdras, and chapter 18 comes after the chapter 17 we just read.
precepts.point: They shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, that is America, and make her afraid. They shall come to her, and besiege her; the star (the missile) and all wrath shall they pour out upon her; then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her. Everybody around America is going to cry when they see it. Here is the precept.

note.label: America: The New Roman Empire

precepts.why:
Ezra says “they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. “They shall come to her, and besiege her, the star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: the star is the missile. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.” Everybody around America is going to cry when they see it.

Here is the precept for it: “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning.” The kings who committed fornication and lived deliciously with her are the ones who did business with America, got rich with her, and did America’s bidding.

They stand “afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” It is the same wording as Esdras: the smoke going up, and those about her bewailing her. And Revelation 18 comes right after the chapter 17 we read, where the great whore and the city are shown.

Then “they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: they become prisoners of war. That is the end of Babylon, America.

precepts.text: The kings of the earth bewail her when they see the smoke of her burning: alas, that great city Babylon, for in one hour is thy judgment come.
precepts.point: Strong winds from the east open it, the silos, and a horrible star with fire, hail and flying swords, the ballistic missiles, breaks down cities, walls, mountains and corn, and they go steadfastly unto Babylon, America, and make her afraid: God is going to make America afraid again. The nations, NATO among them, besiege her and pour out all wrath, the dust and smoke go up to heaven, all about her bewail her, as the kings of the earth in Revelation 18 cry alas that great city in one hour, and they that remain do service to them that put her in fear, prisoners of war.

note.label: Zionism in the Face of Syria & Hezbollah

precepts.why:
Ezra saw the clouds and the horrible star, the missiles, and then “they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. They talk about making America great again; God says he is going to make her afraid again. “They shall come to her, and besiege her”: it will not be a one-on-one fight. The nations, NATO among them, will besiege America and pour out all their wrath upon her. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her.”

Revelation tells the same thing: “And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning, Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.”

The smoke that goes up unto heaven in Ezra is the smoke of her burning in Revelation. The ones about her that bewail her are the kings of the earth who lived deliciously with her, standing afar off in fear. Her judgment comes in one hour.

Then “they that remain under her shall do service unto them that have put her in fear”: prisoners of war. And the party is not over. After the fall of Babylon, the Lord bends Judah for him, fills the bow with Ephraim, and raises up the sons of Zion against the sons of Greece.

precepts.text: There be spirits created for vengeance which in their fury lay on sore strokes in the time of destruction: the angels, who are made spirits and a flame of fire, pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth, and America bombing Iran and killing Palestinians is the Lord behind it.
precepts.point: I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death and destruction, for wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth; I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness. It starts with his spirit on us teaching, and then he comes back and deals with them.

note.label: Trump Is Fulfilling God's Prophecy

precepts.why:
The Lord said, “I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” How does he bring them? Sirach shows it. “All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil.” Then: “There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them.”

God creates spirits for vengeance. The time of destruction is famine, death, plagues and wars, and in that time these spirits pour out their force, and they appease the wrath of the Lord that made them. “Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance”, and “the sword punishing the wicked to destruction.”

So the plagues of 2 Esdras 15 do not come by chance. The Lord is behind the wars you see taking place, Russia and Ukraine, Lebanon, Israel, Palestine, Iran. When you see America bombing Iran and killing all these Palestinians, who is behind that? The Lord is behind that, working it through the spirits he created for vengeance.

note.label: Trump Is Fulfilling God's Prophecy

precepts.why:
Sirach said there be spirits “created for vengeance.” Who are those spirits? Hebrews tells it: “And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.” The Lord makes his angels spirits. So the spirits created for vengeance are the angels.

That is how the Lord keeps his word in 2 Esdras 15, “I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” He does it through his angels, his ministers, a flame of fire, instigating these things in ways we cannot see.

And he says, “I will hold my tongue no more as touching their wickedness.” God is not going to be quiet any more over all the evil being done upon this earth. It starts with him putting his spirit on us and we are teaching, speaking in the ears of his people the words of prophecy, and then he comes back and deals with them the same way.

note.label: Trump Is Fulfilling God's Prophecy

precepts.why:
“And I heard a great voice out of the temple saying to the seven angels, Go your ways, and pour out the vials of the wrath of God upon the earth.” The Lord created spirits for vengeance, and here they are: the angels pouring out the wrath of God upon the earth. Read the whole chapter and it goes into war, civil war, all of it. Who is behind it? The Lord, doing it through the angels.

They just poured some of that vial upon Trump. He came into office: get rid of DEI hiring, no more affirmative action, get rid of black history, take away citizenship from a lot of y’all. The dude is on a rampage, because God put that spirit on him, and a lot of y’all got the American dream and think this place is your rest. Trump thinks he is doing something good, bringing peace, but he is really fulfilling God’s will: bringing affliction on all nations.

May the Lord give Trump seven more years. If he is the one to fulfil God’s will, let him stay in office, even if he is the one that starts putting us to death. Let God’s will be done. Impeach him and the next president will do the same thing, because it is God’s will.

That is 2 Esdras 15 in our day: “I will bring plagues upon the world.” The Lord is the one sending them, the angels are pouring them out, and America is the one he is using to bring death and war, the same way ancient Babylon was used against the nations.

precepts.text: Great fearfulness and trembling, storms from the south, north, west and east, the four winds, and a horrible star and flying swords, the ICBM and the missiles, that break down cities and walls and go steadfastly unto Babylon, America, and make her afraid, and they that be about her bewail her as Revelation 18 says.
precepts.point: Many that sleep in the dust shall awake, some to everlasting life and some to shame. They that be wise, who study, pray and apply, shine as the firmament. The book was sealed to the time of the end, so the open understanding coming out now shows we are in it, and knowledge has increased.

note.label: From Exile & Tribulation to Promise

precepts.why:
Daniel's “time of trouble, such as never was” is World War III and Armageddon. Ezra shows it: “And there shall be great fearfulness and trembling upon earth: and they that see the wrath shall be afraid, and trembling shall come upon them.”

“And then shall there come great storms from the south, and from the north, and another part from the west. And strong winds shall arise from the east”: storms from all four winds.

They “shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star, Fire, and hail, and flying swords”. The horrible star is the ICBM, and the flying swords are the missiles. “And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.”

“And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid.” Babylon is America. And “then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven, and all they that be about her shall bewail her”, just as Revelation 18 says the kings and merchants of the earth will bewail her. That is the time of trouble in which Daniel's people, every one written in the book, shall be delivered.

precepts.text: After Alexander's death they all put crowns upon themselves, so did their sons after them many years, and evils were multiplied in the earth.
precepts.point: I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death, and destruction, for wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth and their hurtful works are fulfilled. Esau did that: Malachi calls Edom the border of wickedness, and 1 Maccabees 1:9 says after Alexander's death evils were multiplied in the earth, from the Greeks through Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Britain, Russia, and America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The Lord says, “I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction. For wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth”. How did wickedness come to pollute the whole earth? Esau. Malachi calls Edom the border of wickedness, and since the time of the Greeks that wickedness has grown and grown.

After Alexander the Greek died, “they all put crowns upon themselves; so did their sons after them many years: and evils were multiplied in the earth.” That is the spread of it: from the Greeks all the way up until today. Do not forget the Romans, Spain, France, Germany, Great Britain, Russia and the United States of America. Each put crowns on themselves, their sons after them, and evils were multiplied.

That is why “their hurtful works are fulfilled”, and why the plagues are coming on the world. Every nation on the face of the earth has been affected by that line of kingdoms, now by America, by Edom. The whole world is defiled because of it.

precepts.text: Arise, shine, for thy light is come: awake to righteousness and go teach. Darkness shall cover the earth, the nations defiled by Edom, and gross darkness the people, God's people, affected by it. But the Lord shall arise upon thee, on those who want to stop sinning, not those taking advantage of his mercy.
precepts.point: I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death, and destruction, for wickedness hath exceedingly polluted the whole earth and their hurtful works are fulfilled. Esau did that: Malachi calls Edom the border of wickedness, and 1 Maccabees 1:9 says after Alexander's death evils were multiplied in the earth, from the Greeks through Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Britain, Russia, and America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The earth is under much wickedness, in gross darkness. Isaiah says, “Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.” Arise: awake to righteousness; it is time to wake up out of that deep sleep. Shine: that is going out to teach, letting your light shine, teaching God's commandments. Our light is Christ.

“For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people”. The darkness covering the earth is the nations: every nation is affected by the United States of America, by Edom, and the whole world is defiled because of this nation. And because of that, the Israelites have been affected: gross darkness the people, God's people.

Then: “but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.” The Lord is still going to arise upon us, because he is still going to choose Israel and have mercy on his people: the ones who want to stop sinning, not the ones who take advantage of God's grace and mercy. His glory shall be seen upon his people.

precepts.text: She saith in her heart, I sit a queen and shall see no sorrow. If you think no harm will come to you in your sins, Amos 9:10, you have Edom's characteristic. You cannot get salvation unless she is destroyed, so remaining in your sins means you want America to continue. This is for the brothers and sisters who fade and always have something more important.

Esau did that: Malachi calls Edom the border of wickedness, and 1 Maccabees 1:9 says after Alexander's death evils were multiplied in the earth, from the Greeks through Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Britain, Russia, and America.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The earth is polluted with wickedness, and Babylon is at the center of it. “How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.”

America really thinks it will never have to pay for its crimes. So if you are sitting in your sins thinking, as Amos 9:10 says, that no harm is going to come to you, you have a characteristic of Edom, the same characteristic as Esau. If we want deliverance, why would we have that mentality? We cannot get salvation unless she is destroyed. So if you want to remain in your sins, you want America to continue.

This is for the brothers and sisters you barely ever see, because they always have something more important than the truth; the ones who fade, and nobody hears from them. This is a gut check, so you can get your mind right. Some of you have embodied the characteristics of America, and it is time to shake that off.

A lot of us look at America as a gorgeous, beautiful woman and are mesmerized. But she is the mother of harlots, and just because you are not picking up a prostitute does not mean you are not out there dealing with harlots. She lives deliciously and thinks she will see no sorrow, but so much torment and sorrow will be given her. Come out of her.

precepts.text: If, delighted with their beauty, they took them to be gods, let them know how much better the Lord of them is, for the first author of beauty hath created them. Real beauty is not the Statue of Liberty; only virgins are beautiful, and God looked at us as beautiful.
precepts.point: I will surely avenge them; my people is led as a flock to the slaughter; I will not suffer them now to dwell in the land of Egypt, but bring them out with a mighty hand and smite Egypt with plagues as before and destroy all the land thereof. As before means a coming Egypt, the United States. When it comes, we do not want to go down with it.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
Ezra says the Lord will not suffer his people “now to dwell in the land of Egypt”, but will “smite Egypt with plagues, as before”. As before means this is not ancient Egypt; it is a coming Egypt, the United States of America. When it comes, we don't want to go down with it. So why would our people love this Egypt? Because of her beauty.

Wisdom answers: “With whose beauty if they being delighted took them to be gods; let them know how much better the Lord of them is: for the first author of beauty hath created them.”

The first author of beauty is our God. Real beauty is not the Statue of Liberty; that is not real beauty. Only virgins are really beautiful. God is the creator of beauty, and he looked at us as beautiful. That is why he refers to us as a woman, as Jeremiah 6:2 shows.

So in this Passover season, get your mind right and remove the leaven. Do not be delighted with the beauty of Egypt and take her for a god. Know how much better the Lord is, who made the beauty.

precepts.why:
The first author of beauty is our God, and he looked at us as beautiful. That is why he refers to us as a woman: “I have likened the daughter of Zion to a comely and delicate woman.”

Comely means beautiful, handsome. That is how the Lord looks at his people: the daughter of Zion is a comely and delicate woman in his eyes.

That is why he says in 2 Esdras that “the innocent and righteous blood crieth unto me”, that “my people is led as a flock to the slaughter”, and that he will surely avenge them. All the murders and injustice done to God's children here in spiritual Egypt are done to the daughter he likened to a comely and delicate woman, and he will not suffer them to dwell in that Egypt any more.

precepts.text: The Lord cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, from rulership to servitude, because we went away from the author who created us and looked to another nation for beauty. America under the skirt is a worn-out harlot who has been with everyone on the block. Knowing that, we return.

As before means a coming Egypt, the United States. When it comes, we do not want to go down with it.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The Lord likened the daughter of Zion to a comely woman, yet Jeremiah laments: “How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!”

The Lord cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven, from rulership, to the earth, to servitude. Why would he do that? Because we went off. We went away from the author who created us. That is why you would look to another nation for its beauty.

But God is letting you know he is the author, the creator of beauty. And America, that you think is beautiful, really is not beautiful. Under the skirt she is a worn-out harlot: you think she is beautiful, then you realize she has been with everyone on the block.

You went against your God. So now, knowing that, we have to return. We have to return back to the author of our beauty, so that he will avenge us and bring us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

precepts.text: Thou lovest righteousness and hatest wickedness, therefore God hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness. Hearken, O daughter, forget thine own people and thy father's house; so shall the king greatly desire thy beauty, for he is thy Lord, and worship thou him. Like a marriage, the Lord will not share us; love righteousness, hate iniquity, and he desires our beauty as he created it.

As before means a coming Egypt, the United States. When it comes, we do not want to go down with it.

note.label: The Beauty And The Beast

precepts.why:
The beauty of Israel was cast down because we left our God, so now we have to return. David shows how: “Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.” We have to love righteousness and hate iniquity.

“All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces”, and “upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.”

“Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father’s house”. The Lord says listen up. Just like a marriage, sisters, you have to focus on your lord. The Lord does not want to share us with anybody else; he wants us to focus on him and him only.

“So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he is thy Lord; and worship thou him.” When we get ourselves right, turn back to the Lord, love righteousness and hate iniquity, he will desire our beauty, the way he created it. And we worship him and him only, not the beauty of Egypt.

precepts.text: Speak in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, our people, not a people of strange speech; they are faithful and true. Fear not the imaginations against thee when you teach against America and governments, for all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness, and I will bring plagues upon the world, the sword, famine, death, and destruction.
precepts.point: I will yet make doctrine to shine as the morning and pour out doctrine as prophecy, and leave it to all ages for ever. I have not laboured for myself only, but for all them that seek wisdom. We do not do this work for ourselves.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
“Behold, speak thou in the ears of my people the words of prophecy, which I will put in thy mouth, saith the Lord”. Speak in the ears of my people. That is why in Ezekiel he said not to go to a people of a strange speech: we have to deal with our people.

“And cause them to be written in paper: for they are faithful and true.” Everything written in the Bible is faithful and true.

“Fear not the imaginations against thee, let not the incredulity of them trouble thee, that speak against thee. For all the unfaithful shall die in their unfaithfulness.” Do not fear what the nations are going to do to us for teaching against America and against governments. The Bible says do not fear.

“Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” The Most High says he is going to bring judgment upon the world. That is the doctrine Sirach says was poured out as prophecy and left to all ages, and we do not labour for ourselves only: we speak it in the ears of our people.

precepts.point: Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, from the rising of the sun, from the south, the Arab nations, from the east, China and India, and Libanus, to turn themselves one against another and repay the things they have done to them.

note.label: America At War With Iran: Preparation For Conflict

precepts.why:
Ezra's vision says, “Behold, saith God, I will call together all the kings of the earth to reverence me, which are from the rising of the sun, from the south, from the east, and Libanus; to turn themselves one against another, and repay the things that they have done to them.” From the south, the Arab nations; from the east, China and India. Joel is the precept to it.
